lines.text: A Vegas club will sell you vodka for seven hundred fifty dollars.
Sparklers, a booth above the crowd, the bottle parade.
Weekend minimums at the top clubs: three to six grand.
Two Grey Goose, one Dom Pérignon. That's your three grand.
Then tax, venue fee and auto-gratuity: up to thirty-eight percent on top.
Your three grand table? Over four thousand dollars.
The same three bottles at a liquor store: about three hundred bucks.
Thirteen times the price. Would you still book the table?

footnote: Estimates; club prices vary by night. Sources: NoCoverVegas, Discotech, Wine-Searcher, Total Wine (2026).
